description: Butter Heavy: independent 8s coating, current body HP 1% per second capped at 2000, immune targets remain mobile. Scorched Earth: 3s current body HP 1% per stack per second, minimum 300. New two-star Embers: independent 3s burn with the same percentage and floor. DOT timers persist in optional save trailers without changing old zombie or portable save layouts. Includes Build76 rejoin waiting.
